title: Mafia
statementMd:
One day $*n*$ friends gathered together to play "Mafia". During each round of the game some player must be the supervisor and other $*n* - 1$ people take part in the game. For each person we know in how many rounds he wants to be a player, not the supervisor: the $*i*$-th person wants to play $*a*_{*i*}$ rounds. What is the minimum number of rounds of the "Mafia" game they need to play to let each person play at least as many rounds as they want?

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$. The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ — the $*i*$-th number in the list is the number of rounds the $*i*$-th person wants to play.

## Output

In a single line print a single integer — the minimum number of game rounds the friends need to let the $*i*$-th person play at least $*a*_{*i*}$ rounds.

Please, do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Note

You don't need to know the rules of "Mafia" to solve this problem. If you're curious, it's a game Russia got from the Soviet times: `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mafia_(party_game)`.
statementZhMd:
一天，$*n*$ 位朋友聚在一起玩“黑手党”。在游戏的每一轮中，必须有一名玩家担任主持人，其他 $*n* - 1$ 人参与游戏。对于每个人，我们知道他希望作为玩家而不是主持人参加多少轮：第 $*i*$ 个人希望参加 $*a*_{*i*}$ 轮。为了让每个人参加至少自己希望的轮数，他们最少需要进行多少轮“黑手党”游戏？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——列表中的第 $*i*$ 个数表示第 $*i*$ 个人希望参加的轮数。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个整数——为了让第 $*i*$ 个人至少参加 $*a*_{*i*}$ 轮游戏，朋友们最少需要进行的游戏轮数。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 说明

你不需要了解“黑手党”的游戏规则就可以解决这道题。如果你对此感到好奇：这是一种俄罗斯从苏联时期流传下来的游戏：`http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mafia_(party_game)`。
